calc_grad_norm: calculate the gradient norm of an iterable of PyTorch parameters with a given p-norm order
recursive_copy_to_device: recursively copy tensors in nested lists, tuples, and dicts to a target device
get_global_rank: get the global rank of a process within a PyTorch distributed process group
create_param_bucket: create a ParamBucket to unify parameter storage as views into a flat buffer tensor
create_grad_bucket: create a GradBucket to unify gradient storage with collapse, rebuild, and shrink operations
